policy.name: discover
policy.reason: High-cost Native Deep and runtime adapters are intentionally unavailable in the M1 discover pass.

interpretation: Completed means the scheduler exhausted all eligible work under this policy; it does not mean route bindings are resolved.
All 14 obligations remain explicit inputs for a later Native Deep or authorized runtime pass.
No model, decompiler, firmware code, or Binwalk process is executed by the scheduler.
